author: SamuelJacob9
body: How many leaving posts have you seen in the last few weeks? On average I reckon their are about 4-6 a day. This shows that Avicus isn't doing enough to keep their veterans as most of the people making these threads have been connected to Avicus for years. I know that some of them are to do irl stuff but I have seen a lot saying they are just bored of the server. Avicus has to do more to keep their players.

Half of the threads as of late are people leaving the network who have recently been banned.
Other people just need to go for IRL reasons.
